import pandas as pd,numpy as np,cv2
im=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); im=cv2.resize(im,None,fx=2,fy=2); o=im.copy()
for f,c in [('demo_metadata.csv',(0,255,0)),('/tmp/out_test/demo_metadata.csv',(0,255,255))]:

cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',np.hstack([im,o]))"
